programme.title: The Rolling Stones: Live at the Fonda
programme.desc: On 20 May 2015, at the Fonda Theatre in Hollywood, the band performed the entire Sticky Fingers album live in concert for the first, and so far only time, in their career.

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.sub-title: 2022: Cynthia Erivo: Legendary Voices at the BBC
programme.desc: Multi award-winning star of stage and screen Cynthia Erivo takes the Proms by storm as she sings the great American songbook of the 1950s and 60s. Backed by the BBC Concert Orchestra, she celebrates the legendary female voices that have shown her the way, artists such as Nina Simone, Shirley Bassey, Billie Holiday, Etta James, and Gladys Knight.

programme.title: Turner: The Man Who Painted Britain
programme.desc: While Joseph Mallord William Turner is considered by many to be Britain's greatest landscape painter, his private life reveals a man of extremes and contradictions. This is a look at the extraordinary story of a brilliant self-made man.

programme.title: Artists and Models
programme.desc: By the middle of the 19th century, Ingres is the grand old man of French painting. His arch-rival Delacroix is still the guiding light of the Romantics. But there is one genius, a contemporary of both men, who has been utterly forgotten.

programme.title: Art of France
programme.desc: Andrew looks at the Impressionists of French art. Andrew plunges into one of the most wildly creative periods in the history of art, when France was changing at a rapid pace and angry young artists would re-invent how to paint, finding their muses in the bars, brothels and cabarets of Belle Epoque Paris and turning the world of art on its head.

programme.title: Mark Lawson Talks to...
programme.desc: Mark Lawson talks to the screenwriter Jimmy McGovern about his life and career in television drama. McGovern shares his memories of working-class Liverpool, how his own struggle with speech drove his love of words, and the lasting impact of Catholicism. After his breakthrough with `Brookside', McGovern pursued his passion for socially and emotionally powerful stories.

programme.title: My Life as a Rolling Stone
programme.desc: Mick Jagger has spent 60 years as frontman for The Rolling Stones. He talks exclusively about his life in the band, from his first performances in local teenage parties to his creation of a stage persona that has defined the rock `n' roll singer.
